verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair question for an MCP registry and platform, so the axis applies. Probes found no such surface: smithery.ai/llms.txt and /docs.md both return 404, and the docs tree was removed after the 2026-10-31 shutdown. Listed servers such as Context7 serve other vendors' docs, and the agent-facing CLI is a different capability, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
